usedFor: Jobber holds quotes, Google Drive holds files, and “When a quote is sent” can start “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new invoice is created” in Jobber, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It makes a file available by link at Viewer, Commenter or Editor level when an invoice is created.

watchOut: “When a job is updated” fires on every update, so the share can run more than once per record.
